status: Read-only bottleneck review while area-first qualification runs; no hardware policy or source changes
interpretation: Large envelopes relative to component courtyard unions are a search-coverage lead, not reclaimable-area estimates: gaps may serve fanout, functional relationships, access and through-hole occupancy. USB-JTAG already has seven opposite-face components in this model. Its top-primary label does not imply all-top placement.
prior_evidence_reused: 2026-10-18-face-catalog-review.json: scoped USB-JTAG component-primary occupancy at 160x150 already failed after 18 outer attempts and 41787 exactly reconciled fallback events. Do not repeat that same campaign or claim envelope decomposition alone solves placement. 2026-10-16-component-scoped-screen.json records additional individual/combined scoped trials on older source.

top_face_rule_review.group_rule: native/src/pcb_placement_variants.cpp pins connector anchors, explicit face-top/through-hole parts and endpoints on impedance-class nets before forming rigid groups.
top_face_rule_review.whole_sheet_rule: native/src/pcb_placement_zones.cpp rejects bottom/either sheet assignments carrying impedance-controlled classes with the diagnostic B.Cu has no emitted reference plane.
top_face_rule_review.emission_evidence: native/src/emit.cpp declares In1.Cu as L2 (GND) and In2.Cu as L3 (PWR); copper_debt.cpp and thermal_checks.cpp explicitly verify emitted In1 ground copper. This review does not establish an equivalent bottom reference plane or signal-integrity qualification.
top_face_rule_review.decision: Retain current impedance-side protection. Class membership is not a universal law requiring top-side parts, but this generator's emitted reference-plane capability is a real dependency. Do not remove it merely to make bottom placement pass or infer safe routing from placement geometry.

next_direction: Focus bounded experiments on independently legal same-face group orientations and compact group shapes around the existing opposite-face assignments. Avoid the previous unbounded rotation-catalog cost; preserve current incumbents and use exact physical/geometry qualification. Additional high-speed bottom eligibility would need a separately evidenced emitted-reference/transition model, not an arbitrary gate waiver.
limits: No new smaller board, extra usable area, hardware safety or routing/fabrication readiness claimed. The separate area-first implementation batch subsequently passed all 278 integrated tests; see 2026-10-18-area-first-pruning.json.
